prompt:
i need you to lit 50 movies with very twisted story you wont expect the ending
your responce should be a list of movies names and years , no any other details , dont seek more info , dont reply by paragarph or any way of responce  only the list

cards.plot: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.
cards.tagline: Not every gift is a blessing.
cards.title: The Sixth Sense

cards.plot: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.
cards.tagline: Sooner or later they’ll find you.
cards.title: The Others

cards.plot: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.
cards.tagline: Are you watching closely?
cards.title: The Prestige

cards.plot: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
cards.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.
cards.title: Fight Club

cards.plot: The lone survivor of an explosive heist gone wrong recounts for interrogators the events that began with five disparate criminals assembled for a police lineup - with alleged criminal mastermind Keyser Soze at the center of it all.
cards.tagline: Five criminals. One line up. No coincidence.
cards.title: The Usual Suspects

cards.plot: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
cards.tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.
cards.title: Se7en

cards.plot: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
cards.tagline: Someone is missing.
cards.title: Shutter Island

cards.plot: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why.
cards.tagline: Some memories are best forgotten.
cards.title: Memento

cards.plot: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.
cards.tagline: 15 years of imprisonment, five days of vengeance.
cards.title: Oldboy

cards.plot: A mother's last wishes send twins Jeanne and Simon on a journey to Middle East in search of their tangled roots. Adapted from Wajdi Mouawad's acclaimed play, Incendies tells the powerful and moving tale of two young adults' voyage to the core of deep-rooted hatred, never-ending wars and enduring love.
cards.tagline: 2 letters. One for the brother. One for the father.
cards.title: Incendies

cards.plot: Predestination chronicles the life of a Temporal Agent sent on an intricate series of time-travel journeys designed to prevent future killers from committing their crimes. Now, on his final assignment, the Agent must stop the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time and prevent a devastating attack in which thousands of lives will be lost.
cards.tagline: To save the future he must reshape the past.
cards.title: Predestination

cards.plot: When Jess sets sail on a yacht with a group of friends, she cannot shake the feeling that there is something wrong.
cards.tagline: Fear Comes in Waves
cards.title: Triangle

cards.plot: Four couples gather for dinner the night a mysterious and powerful comet passes overhead.
cards.tagline: Rearrange your brain.
cards.title: Coherence

cards.plot: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.
cards.tagline: A trip back in time from the present to...
cards.title: Timecrimes

cards.plot: Barcelona, Spain. Adrián Doria, a young and successful businessman accused of murder, meets one night with Virginia Goodman, an expert interrogation lawyer, in order to devise a defense strategy.
cards.tagline: Every story has two sides. The truth, only one.
cards.title: The Invisible Guest

cards.plot: A woman’s body disappears mysteriously from the morgue without a trace. Police inspector Jaime Peña investigates the strange occurrence with the help of Álex Ulloa, the widower of the missing woman.
cards.tagline: Death is not always the end.
cards.title: The Body

cards.plot: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage, intent on reopening it. Before long, her son starts to communicate with a new invisible friend.
cards.tagline: A tale of love. A story of horror.
cards.title: The Orphanage

cards.plot: Two sisters return home after a stay in a mental institution, only to face disturbing events and a strained relationship with their stepmother. As eerie occurrences unfold, dark family secrets begin to surface, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.
cards.tagline: Our sorrow was conceived long before our birth.
cards.title: A Tale of Two Sisters

cards.plot: Jin-seok, 21-year-old, moves into a new house with his family. He suffers from a slight schizophrenia but he carries an ordinary life under the warm care of the family. His older brother Yu-seok is a decent college student, a mentor, and role model for Jin-seok.  One night, his beloved brother is kidnapped by unidentified assailants before Jin-seok's eye. Jin-seok can’t recognize their faces, but can remember only the VIN that matches with no car. After long silence of 19 days, suddenly Yu-seok returns home, but remembers nothing which had happened in the meantime. And soon Jin-seok feels Yu-seok is a total stranger.
cards.tagline: Locked. Erased. Controlled. Isolated. Blurred.
cards.title: Forgotten

cards.plot: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.
cards.tagline: You're the one being tricked.
cards.title: The Handmaiden

cards.plot: Complete strangers stranded at a remote desert motel during a raging storm soon find themselves the target of a deranged murderer. As their numbers thin out, the travelers begin to turn on each other, as each tries to figure out who the killer is.
cards.tagline: The secret lies within.
cards.title: Identity

cards.plot: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.
cards.tagline: Sooner or later, a man who wears two faces forgets which one is real.
cards.title: Primal Fear

cards.plot: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of game. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.
cards.tagline: What do you get for the man who has everything...?
cards.title: The Game

cards.plot: Trevor, an insomniac lathe operator, experiences unusual occurrences at work and home. A strange man follows him everywhere, but no one else seems to notice him.
cards.tagline: How do you wake up from a nightmare if you’re not asleep?
cards.title: The Machinist

cards.plot: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
cards.tagline: 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds... that is when the world will end.
cards.title: Donnie Darko

cards.plot: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
cards.tagline: An actress longing to be a star. A woman searching for herself. Both worlds will collide... on Mulholland Drive.
cards.title: Mulholland Drive

cards.plot: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
cards.tagline: A lost road on the edge of strange...
cards.title: Lost Highway

cards.plot: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.
cards.tagline: The most frightening thing about Jacob Singer's nightmare is that he isn't dreaming.
cards.title: Jacob's Ladder

cards.plot: Two men wake up to find themselves shackled in a grimy, abandoned bathroom. As they struggle to comprehend their predicament, they discover a disturbing tape left behind by the sadistic mastermind known as Jigsaw. With a chilling voice and cryptic instructions, Jigsaw informs them that they must partake in a gruesome game in order to secure their freedom.
cards.tagline: How much blood would you shed to stay alive?
cards.title: Saw

cards.plot: After a violent storm, a dense cloud of mist envelops a small Maine town, trapping David Drayton and his five-year-old son in a local grocery store with other local residents. They soon discover that the mist conceals deadly horrors that threaten their lives, and worse, their sanity.
cards.tagline: Fear changes everything.
cards.title: The Mist

cards.plot: A hospice nurse working at a spooky New Orleans plantation home finds herself entangled in a mystery involving the house's dark past.
cards.tagline: Fearing is believing.
cards.title: The Skeleton Key

cards.plot: After losing their baby, a married couple adopt 9-year old Esther, who may not be as innocent as she seems.
cards.tagline: There's something wrong with Esther.
cards.title: Orphan

cards.plot: A brother and sister are sent to their grandparents' remote Pennsylvania farm for a week, where they discover that the elderly couple is involved in something deeply disturbing.
cards.tagline: No one loves you like your grandparents.
cards.title: The Visit

cards.plot: An ordinary man makes an extraordinary discovery when a train accident leaves his fellow passengers dead — and him unscathed. The answer to this mystery could lie with the mysterious Elijah Price, a man who suffers from a disease that renders his bones as fragile as glass.
cards.tagline: Are you ready for the truth?
cards.title: Unbreakable

cards.plot: When a willful young man tries to venture beyond his sequestered Pennsylvania hamlet, his actions set off a chain of chilling incidents that will alter the community forever.
cards.tagline: There is no turning back
cards.title: The Village

cards.plot: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
cards.tagline: Why are they here?
cards.title: Arrival

cards.plot: With only three weeks left in his three-year contract, Sam Bell is eager to return to Earth. Stationed alone at a Moon-based facility with his computer assistant GERTY, an unexpected accident sets off a series of unsettling events that shake his isolation.
cards.tagline: 250,000 miles from home, the hardest thing to face... is yourself.
cards.title: Moon

cards.plot: When decorated soldier Captain Colter Stevens wakes up in the body of an unknown man, he discovers he's part of a mission to find the bomber of a Chicago commuter train.
cards.tagline: Make every second count.
cards.title: Source Code

cards.plot: A man struggles with memories of his past, including a wife he cannot remember, in a nightmarish world with no sun and run by beings with telekinetic powers who seek the souls of humans.
cards.tagline: They built the city to see what makes us tick. Last night, one of us went off.
cards.title: Dark City

cards.plot: In Los Angeles, a wealthy man, known as Mr. Fuller, discovers a shocking secret about the world he lives in. Fearing for his life, he leaves a desperate message for a friend of his in the most unexpected place.
cards.tagline: Question reality.
cards.title: The Thirteenth Floor

cards.plot: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.
cards.tagline: Everybody's Playing It.
cards.title: eXistenZ

cards.plot: David Aames has it all: wealth, good looks and gorgeous women on his arm. But just as he begins falling for the warmhearted Sofia, his face is horribly disfigured in a car accident. That's just the beginning of his troubles as the lines between illusion and reality, between life and death, are blurred.
cards.tagline: LoveHateDreamsLifeWorkPlayFriendshipSex.
cards.title: Vanilla Sky

cards.plot: Handsome 25-year-old Cesar had it all -- a successful career, expensive cars, a swank bachelor's pad, and an endless string of beautiful and willing women -- until he is thrown into a strange psychological mystery after a car accident scars his face and lands him in prison.
cards.title: Open Your Eyes

cards.plot: Mort Rainey, a writer just emerging from a painful divorce with his ex-wife, is stalked at his remote lake house by a psychotic stranger and would-be scribe who claims Rainey swiped his best story idea. But as Rainey endeavors to prove his innocence, he begins to question his own sanity.
cards.tagline: The most important part of a story is the ending.
cards.title: Secret Window

cards.plot: A mysterious man arrives at the offices of an FBI agent and recounts his childhood: how his religious fanatic father received visions telling him to kill people who were in fact "demons."
cards.tagline: No soul is safe.
cards.title: Frailty

cards.plot: Slevin is mistakenly put in the middle of a personal war between the city’s biggest criminal bosses. Under constant watch, Slevin must try not to get killed by an infamous assassin and come up with an idea of how to get out of his current dilemma.
cards.tagline: Wrong time. Wrong place. Wrong number.
cards.title: Lucky Number Slevin

cards.plot: When teen-socialite Kelly Van Ryan and troubled bad girl Suzie Toller accuse guidance counselor Sam Lombardo of rape, he's suspended by the school, rejected by the town, and fighting to get his life back. One cop suspects conspiracy, but nothing is what it seems...
cards.tagline: They're dying to play with you.
cards.title: Wild Things

cards.plot: Bedraggled college professor Michael Faraday has been vexed — and increasingly paranoid — since his wife's accidental death in a botched FBI operation. When a seemingly all-American couple set up house next door, Michael begins to suspect there’s more to them than meets the eye.
cards.tagline: Fear Thy Neighbor.
cards.title: Arlington Road

cards.plot: An ailing barrister is thrust back into the courtroom in what becomes one of the most unusual and eventful murder cases of the lawyer's career when he finds himself defending a man being tried for the murder of a socialite.
cards.tagline: The most electrifying entertainment of our time!
cards.title: Witness for the Prosecution

cards.plot: The cruel and abusive headmaster of a boarding school, Michel Delassalle, is murdered by an unlikely duo -- his meek wife and the mistress he brazenly flaunts. The women become increasingly unhinged by a series of odd occurrences after Delassalle's corpse mysteriously disappears.
cards.tagline: See it, be amazed at it, but...BE QUIET ABOUT IT!
cards.title: Diabolique
